body: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.
summaryZh: EmbodiedRSI是一种用于机器人基础模型的自进化智能体框架，旨在解决模型在环境变化时的性能退化问题。该框架采用快慢双系统架构，通过假设图维护多种代码与技能假设，并利用信息价值选择物理实验进行验证，从而驱动代码与技能的协同进化。实验表明，EmbodiedRSI在多个机器人基准测试中表现优异，并能实现零样本迁移至真实机器人环境，显著提升了机器人持续学习的效率与适应性。

aiReview.reasonZh: EmbodiedRSI通过假设引导的协同进化机制，实现了机器人模型在复杂环境下的自主适应与持续学习。

glossary.explanationZh: 视觉运动控制，指机器人根据视觉输入执行动作。
持续学习，指模型在不断变化的环境中学习新知识而不遗忘旧知识。
假设图，用于存储和管理多种可能的技能或代码假设。
信息价值，用于评估实验对减少不确定性的贡献。
